content.thinking: `/usr/bin/time` not available. Let me use Python's resource module to measure from within a wrapper, or use `time` builtin and read /proc. Let me use a Python wrapper with resource.getrusage and subprocess.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - << 'EOF'
import resource, subprocess, sys, time, os
t0=time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '/workspace/submission/main.py'], stdin=open('heavy.jsonl','rb'), stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
el = time.time()-t0
ru = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print('elapsed %.2fs user %.2fs sys %.2fs maxrss %.1f MB stdout %.1f MB' % (el, ru.ru_utime, ru.ru_stime, ru.ru_maxrss/1024, len(p.stdout)/1e6))
print(p.stdout[:100], p.stdout[-60:])
EOF
